Game Overview

At its heart, Road Race 3D is a casual game about race through wild 3D tracks blending speed and parkour in Road Race 3D. Outmaneuver dynamic obstacles, collect gems, and upgrade your ride to conquer challenges. With thrilling surprises and unique routes, strategize your way to victory using tanks and ships for an unstoppable edge.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Road Race 3D is easy to pick up. Race through wild 3D tracks blending speed and parkour in Road Race 3D! Outmaneuver dynamic obstacles, collect gems, and upgrade your ride to conquer challenges. With thrilling surprises and unique routes, strategize your way to victory using tanks and ships for an unstoppable edge.
